occurrence.text: The political psychic cycle has the same dynamic shape. Atomisation and loss of meaningful relation leave affect unbound; a single narrative can bind that affect by intensifying one branch and converting the excluded branch into the cause of the field's pain. The resolution is real as affect but false as ground: the local determination has occupied `0`. Divine and concur reopens the basin—not by dissolving conflict, but by restoring the relational field in which differentiated parties can become mutually answerable. The institutional question remains irreducible: no psychic account is adequate unless it asks how offices, media, property, and coercion stabilise or interrupt the cycle.

current_literal_return_fragments.text: [E2’s arbitration in crisis](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md#arbitration-in-crisis) gives this movement its relational test for a change of regime: Con-text exposes the conditions under which arbitration has operated, and Resolution lets consequence revise them. The distinction between movement within a basin and transformation of its governing regime remains necessary. The E-field supplies that operation of return; it does not constitute empirical proof of a particular dynamical model.

[M03](../../../../section-rooms/00-integral-threshold/movements/03-s01-p2-definition-cut-gift-danger.md) receives productive distinction before source-usurpation; [M05](../../../../section-rooms/00-integral-threshold/movements/05-s01-p4-gebser-diaphaneity.md) and [M35](../../../../section-rooms/05-psychoid-flowering/movements/35-s4-p4-gebser-apollo-dionysus.md) receive perspective's disclosure of its conditions. [M40](../../../../section-rooms/06-objective-internality/movements/40-s5-p3-preference-hidden-zero.md) receives the finite evaluator's hidden conditioning, distinguished from metaphysical Zero and from trust. [M42](../../../../section-rooms/06-objective-internality/movements/42-s5-p5-research-vectors.md) receives an Offered gauge/return experiment; [M43](../../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/43-s50-p0-theory-vocation-compassion.md) receives the loving manner of return; [M46](../../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/46-s50-p3-4-2-mono-poly.md) receives contestable local rule and common consequence without an infallible master reference field. Each Movement receives the relation at its own scale: the field keeps the generated operation recoverable through those differences.

occurrence.text:
## Tension / limit
Exposing a gauge makes value conflict attributable and revisable: participants can see which comparison, baseline, or preference function produced the decision and contest it at the right level.

current_literal_return_fragments.text:
[E2’s con text through diaphaneity](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md#con-text-through-diaphaneity) carries preference’s concealed conditions back to the criterion that selected and evaluated the answer. Increased observability can expose those conditions while leaving the evaluator protected. Regard becomes consequential when what is disclosed can revise the criterion and its commission; a finite hidden condition is not thereby identified with metaphysical Zero.
**Mathematical anchor:** preference values identifiable through comparative relations and reference frames. **Political image:** the hidden zero as invisible governor. [[Mono-Poly: Whole and Many]] asks how dependencies remain shared without a metric claiming the whole; [[Trust, Faith, and the Formal Limit]] asks whether the relation to those dependencies has become honest enough for trust to be risked. ## Warrant
The unit can nest across sentence, claim, agent, research programme, and institution while retaining source and disagreement. [[submission-package/epi-logos/resources/mef-12-lenses-sublens-reference|MEF 12 Lenses and Sublenses]] supplies the initial diaphaneity seed. The architecture answers Agentworld's conceptual-language lag by giving humans and agents a common set of operations—distinguish, exclude, relate, compose, contextualise, return—without forcing one ontology or hiding every machine process behind a humanoid mask.

current_literal_return_fragments.text: The [Symbol / Account / Trust whole-field — Account does not replace source](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md#account-does-not-replace-source) **qualifies** this operation at evidence register 3. A bounded Bimba reference field remains inspectable and revisable in its wider context. The harness carries source, gauge, exclusion and consequence so the account’s return can reach its own reference office. The resulting distinction **returns-to** that whole field with the consumer’s own source and evidential limits retained.

current_literal_forward_fragments.text: The Movement return also has distinct tasks. [M20](../../../../section-rooms/03-two-logics/movements/20-s2-p1-dia-ballein.md) **extends** the loss of source and recomposition after a cut; [M21](../../../../section-rooms/03-two-logics/movements/21-s2-p2-sym-ballein.md) **extends** the provisional anchor whose seam remains executable. [M40](../../../../section-rooms/06-objective-internality/movements/40-s5-p3-preference-hidden-zero.md) **tests** the difference between exposing an evaluator's conditions and warranted reliance. [M44](../../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/44-s50-p1-ql-mef-bimba-harness.md) **extends** the inspectable return through a harness, while [M48](../../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/48-s50-p5-ahi-planetary-return.md) **returns-to** source and affected worlds after a determination has acted. Their source-specific historical claims and implementation duties remain with those movements. No common list of labels substitutes for their different consequences.

edits.old: When the mark re-enters the space it distinguishes, the system cannot settle into one timeless value. It oscillates between its states. [[varela-1975-calculus-self-reference|Varela]] and the calculus of self-reference develop this consequence: re-entry gives the binary a temporal dimension and turns contradiction into dynamism. The present state carries its prior crossing as memory.
edits.new: The essay’s Argued temporal reading treats a re-entering mark as carrying its prior crossing into the next state as memory. [[varela-1975-calculus-self-reference|Varela]] formally introduces an [autonomous third state](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/varela/varela-1975-calculus-self-reference/SOURCE.md#varela-1975-calculus-self-reference-q001). His [temporal and systemic interpretations](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/varela/varela-1975-calculus-self-reference/SOURCE.md#varela-1975-calculus-self-reference-q002) leave frequency characterisation for further investigation. The [frequency-to-retention task](../../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/formal-limit.md#frequency-retention-and-signed-dia-research) must specify what recurs, how frequency is measured, what retains the prior state and how that retention changes the next crossing. Varela’s calculus does not itself complete that authorial chain.
